name: semantic-visual-loom
description: A foundation that carries a story all the way to film. Footage is not generated — it is edited. State is placed outside the generation, in one production ledger holding continuity and disclosure together, and the reference set and the forbidden set are derived from that single point. Pre-flight verification fires the breakdowns in the design without running a single generation. The unit is the shot: one shot exists for one change, and length is a dependent variable.
